title: Launch Extensions
description: Five independent studies that extend the season-launch language to adjacent broadcast and promotional surfaces.
creative_direction: Independent rollout studies for League Season Launch Visual Kit. These images test how a season-opening system can stretch across collateral, hero surfaces, and broadcast-support modules while staying brandless and practical.
